Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: rtlpp_08239_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: rtlpp_08239_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_08239 (
    input   [  1: 0] address,
    input            chipselect,
    input            clk,
    input            reset_n,
    input            write_n,
    input   [ 31: 0] writedata,
    output  [  7: 0] out_port,
    output  [ 31: 0] readdata
);

  wire             clk_en;
  reg     [  7: 0] data_out;
  wire    [  7: 0] read_mux_out;

  assign clk_en = 1;
  assign read_mux_out = {8 {(address == 0)}} & data_out;

  always @(posedge clk or negedge reset_n)
    begin
      if (~reset_n)
          data_out <= 8'b0;
      else if (chipselect && ~write_n && (address == 0))
          data_out <= writedata[7 : 0];
    end

  assign readdata = {32'b0 | read_mux_out};
  assign out_port = data_out;

endmodule
